title: A forwarded answer that times out is not left waiting on the forwarding base
goal: Reconcile the forwarded-answer timeout: once sent, the answer belongs to the main base, so the forwarding base never takes a later message as a second answer
acceptance: A committed regression fails before the fix: the forwarding base keeps the question open after a late reply
After the fix the forwarding base closes its copy as failed and the next message is a new sortie, forwarded as a new request
An answer that never reached the main base (connection failed, not seen as main here, or turned away with 400/401/403/409) still keeps the question waiting and never runs locally
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; scripted model server, no real model or private hosts
validation: Independent review before the parent closes
escalation: Never run a forwarded answer locally
Do not weaken the never-sent versus sent distinction of KajiLink.chat
